```lean
intro x hx
let n := ⌊x⌋₊
have h1 : n ≤ x := floor_le x
have h2 : n ≥ 1 := le_floor_iff.1 (lt_trans hx (le_refl x))
have h3 : Real.log √x = Real.log x / 2 := Real.log_sqrt (by linarith)
have h4 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x = Real.log 4 * x / (Real.log x / 2) + √x :=
  by rw [h3, div_div_eq_div_mul_right]
have h5 : Real.log x / 2 > 0 := Real.mul_log_pos hx
have h6 : Real.log 4 * x / (Real.log x / 2) + √x = (Real.log 4 * x * 2 / Real.log x) + √x :=
  by rw [h4, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_inv_eq_div]
have h7 : 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + √x = (2 * x * Real.log 4 + √x * Real.log x) / Real.log x :=
  by rw [h6, add_div, mul_add]
have h8 : Real.log x ≤ x - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx
have h9 : √x * Real.log x ≤ √x * x :=
  by { apply mul_le_mul_left, exact (Real.log x ≤ x - 1).1 h8 }
have h10 : 2 * x * Real.log 4 + √x * Real.log x ≤ 2 * x * Real.log 4 + √x * x :=
  by { apply add_le_add, exact h9 }
have h11 : √x * x = x^(3/2) := by rw [pow_add, pow_one]
have h12 : 2 * x * Real.log 4 + √x * x ≤ 2 * x * Real.log 4 + x^(3/2) :=
  by { apply add_le_add, exact h11 }
have h13 : 2 * x * Real.log 4 + x^(3/2) ≤ (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4) :=
  by refl
have h14 : (2 * x * Real.log 4 + x^(3/2)) / Real.log x ≤ (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4) / Real.log x :=
  by { apply le_div_iff, exact h13 }
have h15 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ n := primeCounting_le_self
have h16 : n ≤ x := h1
have h17 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ x := h15.trans h16
have h18 : (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4) / Real.log x ≥ x :=
  by { apply div_ge_iff.mpr, exact (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4 ≥ x * Real.log x).1 (by linarith) }
have h19 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4) / Real.log x :=
  by { apply le_trans h17 h14 }
have h20 : (x^(3/2) + 2 * x * Real.log 4) / Real.log x ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
  by { rw h4, exact h12 }
have h21 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
  by { apply le_trans h19 h20 }
exact h21
```
